title: Eurobeat
style: Dance, Eurobeat, cute, J-Pop Style, EDM Style, male vocal
lyrics:
(Verse 1)
Woke up in a technicolor dream
You and me, we’re the perfect team.
Every step is like a dance
Caught up in this neon romance.

(Pre-Chorus)
Cotton candy clouds above
Every beat spells out our love.
Electric hearts that sync in time
Your smile turns my world to rhyme.

(Chorus)
Sparkling lights and lucky days
Riding through these magic waves.
Holding hands, we chase the sun
Life with you is just pure fun.
Flash and color everywhere
J-Pop love fills the air.

(Verse 2)
Jump so high, the sky feels near
Laughter rings in every ear.
Confetti thoughts and rainbow cheer
You’re the song I want to hear.

(Pre-Chorus)
Cotton candy clouds above
Every beat spells out our love.
Electric hearts that sync in time
Your smile turns my world to rhyme.

(Chorus)
Sparkling lights and lucky days
Riding through these magic waves.
Holding hands, we chase the sun
Life with you is just pure fun.
Flash and color everywhere
J-Pop love fills the air.

(Bridge)
Every second, like a game
But you and I, we’re not the same.
Falling stars spell out your name
In this rhythm, love became.

(Final Chorus)
Sparkling lights and lucky days
In your arms, I want to stay.
Dancing fast, no time to waste
You're the beat I always chase.
Forever starts with you and me
In this sweet J-Pop melody.
